name: advanced-assembling-machine-improved
title: Advanced Assembly Machines: Improved
author: johnmart19
description: Five assembler tiers, speeds 20–320, each available simultaneously as Small 3x3 and Large 5x5. Large supports 24 item ingredients and four input/four output fluid ports; Small retains 12 ingredients and two input/two output ports. Shared tier technologies, separate upgrade chains, configurable module slots and native activity animations. Preserves existing compact and original four-port factories.
